context: A small clinic in Fukuoka. Goro has come in (against his preference) for a routine check. Dr. Saito is on a one-day visiting rotation.
purpose: gruff old man at the doctor — Kyushu drawl meets clinical calm

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こちら、おかけください。今日はどうされましたか？
lines.en: Please, have a seat. What brings you in today?
lines.style: Calm, professional, even. Eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Kyushu drawl, half-grumbling. Sits down anyway.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: (small smile) なるほど。最近、どこか痛みは？
lines.en: (small smile) I see. Any pain anywhere lately?
lines.style: A real small smile audible. Diagnostic but warm.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 膝な、少し。歩いたら、もうな。
lines.en: Knee — a little. When I walk, well — you know.
lines.style: Pats his own knee in the voice. Reluctant honest admission.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 見せていただいてもいいですか。
lines.style: Formal, asking permission. Doesn't touch first.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Single word. Permission given, not enthusiastically.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: うん。少し炎症がありますね。本当に、無理せずに。
lines.en: Mm. There's some inflammation. Please don't push yourself.
lines.style: Clinical observation paired with real warmth on 「本当に」.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: I used to be a fisherman, back then.
lines.style: Non sequitur but real. Explaining himself indirectly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: だからこそ、今、大切に。お時間、もう少し取れますか？
lines.en: Exactly why — be careful now. Can I have a bit more of your time?
lines.style: Doesn't patronise. Asks like he's the boss.
